content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing an issue with the M8 marker on startup using the [product_name] [version_no] ([article_no]) with Firmware [version_no]. The M8 flag is being set twice instead of just once during a cold startup (after power reset), while on a warm startup (triggered by online commands), it works correctly (sets only once). The same logic works fine with an earlier [product_name] ([version_no], [article_no], Firmware [version_no]). Has anyone encountered this before? Is this a new [company_name] behavior for cold startups? Appreciate any insights.

Welcome to the forum. I also have a [article_no] with Firmware [version_no]. I ran a test with a simple program and could not replicate your issue. Both cold and warm starts result in the M8 marker being set only once during the first cycle.
I couldn't reproduce the error either with my setup. It's possible the issue lies within your program, for example if you're using edge-triggered logic like AND functions.

Thanks for your response. Would sharing my program be helpful for further troubleshooting? I'm using a DM16 24 expansion card ([article_no]) attached to the right of the controller. Do you think the card could have any impact on this issue? Thanks. [user_name]

The DM16 module shouldn't be the cause of the issue. Often, program errors can be subtle. Please upload your program so we can review it together. Note that you'll need to compress it into a ZIP file before uploading. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are investigating a case where a marker flag is unexpectedly triggered twice on cold startup with a specific [product_name] version, while previous hardware and firmware versions do not show the same behavior. Other users with similar hardware and firmware setups did not encounter the same issue, pointing toward a program-specific problem instead of a widespread firmware or hardware defect. Both hardware configuration and program logic are being considered as possible causes.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates consistent and reliable marker flag operation across firmware versions and startup methods, aiming for the M8 marker to be set only once on cold startup, just like it was with prior device versions.
